units: <cite ref="Pesachim 54a:14">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ שנברא העולם</he> before the world was created.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:4">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ק׳ לאותו שכתוב בו וכ׳</he> prior to that (divine throne) about which is written, ‘firm is thy throne &c.’ (<cite ref="Psalms 93:2">Ps. XCIII, 2</cite>).

<cite ref="Psalms 93:2">Ib.</cite> s. 9 <he>ק׳ לכן</he> ere this. Ib. <he>ק׳ עד שלא נוצרה וכ׳</he> long before &c., v. <cite ref="J00548"><he>יָצַר</he></cite>. Ib. s. 21 (ref. to <he>מקדם</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:8">Gen. II, 8</cite>) <he>מק׳ לג״ע נבראת וכ׳</he> Gehenna was created before the garden of Eden; Yalk. ib. 34 <he>מקֶדֶם</he>. Gen. R. l. c. <he>קֶדֶם לג״ע וכ׳</he> the angels were created before &c.; Yalk. l. c. <he>מקדם</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 24:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV</cite> <he>כמקדם</he> as before; a. fr.
